dict.string: Pocketd reads your calendar to tell you what's next, and adds events when you ask. If you choose Apple Private Cloud Compute, Apple processes relevant event details for your answers and briefs.
Pocketd reads your sleep, activity and heart data to compare today with your usual. If you choose Apple Private Cloud Compute, Apple processes relevant health summaries for your answers and briefs.
Pocketd does not write to Health. This permission is requested only because iOS requires the description to be present whenever an app links HealthKit.
When you turn on Use from your laptop, Pocketd answers your other devices over your Wi-Fi. Their questions are answered by a downloaded brain on this iPhone, not by Apple Private Cloud Compute.
Pocketd listens while the microphone is on to turn your question into text. Your microphone audio is processed on this iPhone and is never uploaded.

Pocketd reads your reminders to tell you what's due, and adds or ticks them off when you ask. If you choose Apple Private Cloud Compute, Apple processes relevant reminder details for your answers and briefs.
Pocketd turns your voice into text on this iPhone so you can ask by speaking. Audio is processed on the device and never uploaded.
